entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Judy. How can I help you today?
Hi Judy. I need to make a return for a VeloBand Cadence Sensor I recently bought.
I can certainly help with that. Can I get your name and the order number, please?
Sure, the name is Alex Chen, and the order number is VF88712.
One moment, Alex... Okay, I have your account pulled up. I see you purchased the VeloBand on December 15th. I also see you're one of our VIP members! We really appreciate your loyalty.
Thanks. Yes, I've been with you guys for a while. So, can I return it?
Yes, absolutely. **No problem** at all. Our policy allows for returns within **90 days** of delivery, so you are well within that window.
Oh, that's a relief. I was worried I had missed the deadline.

Not at all. I've just approved the return for you. I'm emailing the pre-paid **return label** to the address on file right now. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off. As a small thank you for being a VIP, I've also added a $15 credit to your account for future use.
Wow, thank you, Judy! That was much easier than I expected.
It's my pleasure, Alex. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that was it. You've been a great help.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
